speak.title: Role-play: should I reply?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.role: the person who got the message
a.text: An old classmate who treated you badly has sent you a friendly message after many years. You are curious and want to reply. Explain why, and say what worries you.

b.text: You think your friend should be careful. Ask questions, give your opinion, and suggest what to do. You can say reply, ignore it, or reply with conditions.

phrases: I've just had a message from someone I haven't heard from for years.
Part of me wants to find out why they wrote.
What if they're only after something?
Maybe you could reply, but keep it short.
I'm still angry, but I don't want to be bitter.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: what did your pair decide, and why?
